headline: Colonials Advance in Nevish Line as Wardens Take Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Colonial spearheads have overturned the northern balance along the Nevish Line, capturing two additional strongholds to establish a commanding six-to-two advantage over Warden garrisons following vicious clashes at Mistle Shrine and Grief Mother that produced more than 4,100 casualties in two hours. Conversely, Warden forces executed a decisive push across the Weathered Expanse, breaking the sector's prior deadlock to secure five redoubts against a solitary Colonial outpost, leaving three contested strongpoints in neutral ruin amid swirling artillery duels at Crow’s Nest and Wightwalk. Linn of Mercy remains the front's bloodiest slaughterhouse, absorbing over 5,300 casualties and five strategic flips in the past two hours alone as the struggle over Lathair and Outwich Ranch leaves seven bases in Colonial hands, two with the Wardens, and two pulverized into no-man's-land. Behind these primary battlegrounds, the guns have fallen silent across Mooring County and Stonecradle, whereas Callahan's Passage and Marban Hollow exhibit sudden upticks in enlistments and skirmishing along their heavily contested borders.
